description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 2] and [Last Stand] to all allies, grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Linked Materia Mode III (Wind, Holy)], [Boundless Dreams Follow-Up] and Fierce Pride +1 to the user

description.name: Barrage of Gluttony
description.text: Six single attacks (0.90 each) with additional 20% critical damage, grants [Wind Ability +30% Boost 1] to the user if Cloud or Zack are alive

description.name: Clutching Blow
description.text: One single attack (6.00) capped at 99999, grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 2] to all allies if the user has Fierce Pride level 1, removes Fierce Pride from the user

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 2
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next two attacks

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: Linked Materia Mode III (Wind, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Holy 2 with Stacking] after using a Wind/Holy ability

description.name: Boundless Dreams Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Boundless Dreams when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
